principle: PC003 owns DETERMINISTIC NUMERIC gates on training health; the semantic Judge reviews but does NOT replace numeric gates

deterministic_checks.training_divergence: NaN/Inf in loss, or valid loss increasing monotonically over the early-stopping patience window -> FAIL
deterministic_checks.persistent_student_underfit_to_teacher: final valid force RMSE (student vs teacher labels) above a to-be-calibrated bound; recorded per seed (historical v6 reference 0.284-0.289 eV/A)
deterministic_checks.committee_instability: cross-seed spread of valid E/F RMSE beyond a tolerance; and per-atom u_alpha distribution sane (finite, non-degenerate)
deterministic_checks.catastrophic_domain_error: per-domain valid force RMSE (amorphous/dilute/clustered/broad) — flag any domain with RMSE >> committee median
deterministic_checks.preprocessing_data_failure: missing feature pickles, struct_weight not applied (weighted flag), element-order mismatch, or manifest-hash mismatch -> FAIL

outputs_for_PC004: per-seed LOG (E/F RMSE train/valid per epoch)
committee per-atom u_alpha on the 558 valid set
threshold_policy: acceptance thresholds are NOT chosen now (no results exist); to be set from actual training + PC004; only structural/mechanical checks (NaN, monotone divergence, missing data) are hard now
judge_role: Judge committee reviews the PC003 PROPOSAL and later the training report for consistency/omissions; deterministic numeric gates remain authoritative
